card.name: Linking words in electron physics text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, as, into, between, a, single, more) in physics news text about electrons, carrier multiplication and superconducting pairs, just before the next physics term.

modes.label: Linking words before electrons
modes.description: A preposition or article right before a phrase about electrons or states in a solid-state physics passage.

modes.label: Words about single or paired systems
modes.description: Words such as as, single or more in descriptions of electron pairs acting together.
modes.example: together act<< as>> a single system.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear, but it weakly favors physics terms like spin and propagation as next words.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words inside physics passages about electrons, not on any medical wording.
